block.madscience.abomination_egg.tooltip: Spawned into the world when The Abomination kills another living creature, mob or player alike.
block.madscience.clay_furnace.tooltip: Ancient technology that can give a source block from a single ore. Requires a block of coal and to be lit on fire.
block.madscience.cnc_machine.tooltip: Computer Numerical Control: cuts blocks of iron into weapon parts, programmed by a written book naming the part (in plain text or binary). Needs water, power and a redstone signal.
block.madscience.cryotube.tooltip: Harvests electrical power from villagers' memories! Needs a redstone signal, a villager spawn egg, a data reel and a nether star.
block.madscience.dna_extractor.tooltip: Extracts DNA samples from filled syringes.
block.madscience.duplicator.tooltip: Creates copies of any data reel. Needs a redstone signal.
block.madscience.freezer.tooltip: Restores filled syringes and DNA samples to full health. Runs on snow and ice.
block.madscience.incubator.tooltip: Reads sequenced genomes and encodes this information onto chicken eggs. Needs power and a redstone signal to heat up.
block.madscience.magazine_loader.tooltip: Automatically loads rounds into empty Pulse Rifle magazines, 95 at a time. Requires power and a redstone signal to operate.
block.madscience.mainframe.tooltip: Combines multiple sequenced genomes together to make new lifeforms. Needs power, a redstone signal and water to keep cool.
block.madscience.meat_cube.tooltip: [Slime + Pig, Chicken or Cow] Punch it for meat. Feed it Liquid Mutant DNA to grow the meat back.
block.madscience.sanitizer.tooltip: Cleans dirty needles so they can be reused.
block.madscience.sequencer.tooltip: Reads DNA samples into data reels to create sequenced genomes.
block.madscience.soniclocator.tooltip: Replaces target blocks in a given chunk with gravel, and keeps the target block. Needs power and a redstone signal.
block.madscience.thermosonic_bonder.tool: Used to electrically interconnect the all-important Silicon Wafers, Transistors, CPUs and RAM chips. Needs power and a redstone signal to heat up.
block.madscience.vox_box.tooltip: Public address system for relaying announcements. Put a written book in and give it power and a redstone pulse.
gui.madscience.clay_furnace_hint: Light with flint and steel. Hit it when it stops burning, wait for it to cool, then hit it again.
gui.madscience.input_cnc_book: Input written book naming the part
item.madscience.circuit_comparator.toolt: Enables electronic devices to compare items to other items.
item.madscience.circuit_diamond.tooltip: Advanced circuit used as central core in several machines.
item.madscience.circuit_emerald.tooltip: Advanced circuit that is used in the creation of some of the most scientifically accurate equipment known to Minecraft.
item.madscience.circuit_ender_eye.toolti: Advanced circuit that controls sorting data inside of machines. Using the same technology that guides you to Strongholds, this circuit can move huge data-sets around and know exactly where they should go.
item.madscience.circuit_ender_pearl.tool: Very powerful monitoring circuit that can hold data in a seemingly infinite buffer thanks to the magic of Enderman teleportation technology.
item.madscience.circuit_redstone.tooltip: Creates a multi-purpose circuit that accepts digital data as input, processes it according to instructions stored in its memory, and provides results as output.
item.madscience.circuit_spider_eye.toolt: Sensitive circuit that is used in monitoring and analysis of items not directly visible to the naked eye.
item.madscience.component_case.tooltip: A computer case, also known as a "computer chassis", "tower" or simply "case", is the enclosure that contains most of the components of a computer.
item.madscience.component_computer.toolt: A computer is a general purpose device that can be programmed to carry out a set of arithmetic or logical operations.
item.madscience.component_cpu.tooltip: A central processing unit (CPU) is the hardware within a computer that carries out the instructions of a computer program by performing the basic arithmetical, logical, and input/output operations of the system.
item.madscience.component_enderslime.too: Used in the creation of a Thumper which then goes into your Soniclocator.
item.madscience.component_fan.tooltip: A computer fan is any fan inside, or attached to, a computer case used for active cooling.
item.madscience.component_fused_quartz.t: Fused quartz is glass consisting of silica in amorphous (non-crystalline) form. Its optical and thermal properties are superior to those of other types of glass due to its purity.
Magnetic tape data storage uses digital recording on magnetic tape to store digital information. Modern magnetic tape is most commonly packaged in data reels.
item.madscience.component_power_supply.t: Provides consistent and clean power to machines and computer equipment.
item.madscience.component_pulse_rifle_ba: Metal tube through which a controlled explosion is released in order to propel a projectile out of the end at a high velocity.
item.madscience.component_pulse_rifle_bo: Mechanical part of a firearm that blocks the rear of the chamber while the propellant burns, but moves out of the way to allow another cartridge or shell to be inserted in the chamber.
item.madscience.component_pulse_rifle_bu: An empty bullet casing that needs to be filled to become a finished round for the Pulse Rifle.
item.madscience.component_pulse_rifle_gr: An empty grenade casing that needs to be filled to become a finished grenade for the Pulse Rifle.
item.madscience.component_pulse_rifle_re: Part of the Pulse Rifle that houses the operating parts.
item.madscience.component_pulse_rifle_tr: Actuates the firing sequence of the Pulse Rifle.
item.madscience.component_ram.tooltip: Random-access memory (RAM) is a form of computer data storage. A random-access device allows stored data to be accessed directly in any random order.
item.madscience.component_screen.tooltip: A monitor or a display is an electronic visual display for computers.
A wafer is a thin slice of semiconductor material, such as a silicon crystal, used in the fabrication of integrated circuits and other microdevices.
item.madscience.component_thumper.toolti: Used in the recipe for the Soniclocator. The Soniclocator builds up energy in the goop inside these thumpers, which was collected from the Enderslime mob.
item.madscience.component_transistor.too: A transistor is a semiconductor device used to amplify and switch electronic signals and electrical power.
item.madscience.data_reel_empty.tooltip: Magnetic tape data storage. This reel is empty and may have any sort of data imprinted onto it.

item.madscience.lab_coat_body.tooltip: Gives off the distinct signal that you are, in fact, a scientist.
item.madscience.lab_coat_leggings.toolti: "I soak my white socks in coffee, so I can wear them with brown pants and keep my feet from falling asleep."
item.madscience.liquid_dna_bucket.toolti: Filled bucket of liquid DNA from an organism that is not a mutant.
item.madscience.memory_blacksmith.toolti: High quality data and many ideas and experiences.
item.madscience.memory_butcher.tooltip: Good data with input from a variety of sources, only a few ideas.
item.madscience.memory_farmer.tooltip: Data set is filled with the same repeating patterns over and over.
item.madscience.memory_librarian.tooltip: Best data recorded, each bit is unique and packed with ideas and experiences out of this world.
item.madscience.memory_priest.tooltip: Filled with huge gaps of data and very minimal flow of ideas.
item.madscience.mutant_dna_bucket.toolti: Filled bucket of corrosive mutant DNA. Highly incompatible with organisms that are not mutants. Use extreme caution when handling!
item.madscience.pulse_rifle.tooltip: Hold attack to fire. Use to switch between rounds and the grenade launcher; sneak and use to reload or unload.
item.madscience.pulse_rifle_grenade.tool: High explosive fragmentation grenade for the Pulse Rifle's launcher. It holds four.
item.madscience.pulse_rifle_magazine.too: Holds up to 99 rounds. Craft it with rounds to load it, or craft it on its own to unload it.
item.madscience.pulse_rifle_round.toolti: Explosive-tipped caseless round. Load them into a magazine.
item.madscience.syringe_bat.tooltip: Blood drawn from a living creature. Goes bad over time unless kept in a Cryogenic Freezer.

item.madscience.warning_sign.tooltip: Contains several standardized symbols for harmful or dangerous materials. Sneak and hit a placed sign to change its symbol.
message.madscience.pulse_rifle_disabled: The Pulse Rifle is disabled on this server.
warning_sign.madscience.battery: Danger from batteries acid or explosions, wear protection!
warning_sign.madscience.biohazard: Biological substances that pose bodily harm or death.
warning_sign.madscience.conveyor: Conveyor belt system or tracks in immediate area.
warning_sign.madscience.electromagnetic_: Non-ionising electromagnetic radiation in current area.
warning_sign.madscience.entanglement: Risk of entanglement and dismemberment, be aware of your surroundings!
warning_sign.madscience.explosible_regio: This area is an explosible region use extreme caution!

warning_sign.madscience.falling: Risk of falling, watch your step!
warning_sign.madscience.finger_sandwich: Risk of severe hand injury or disfigurement.
warning_sign.madscience.generic_warning: Generic warning symbol, be aware of your surroundings!
warning_sign.madscience.low_ceiling: Low hanging ceiling, watch your step!
warning_sign.madscience.optical_radiatio: Optical radiation present in area, use protection.
warning_sign.madscience.oxidising: Oxidising substances will react with surrounding air!
warning_sign.madscience.pointy: Pointy objects are within the present area, watch your step.
warning_sign.madscience.poisonous: Poisonous substances in area, risk of death!
